name: atlantis-provider-neutral-stale-commit-fc78
instr:
Atlantis cannot discover and retire stale commit statuses across providers without risking current or external CI results. Reconcile the complete desired status set only after plan or apply knows it, against the pull's current head. Preserve publication identity and output, and report cleanup failures.

Clients from `github.New`, `gitlab.New`, `azuredevops.New`, `bitbucketcloud.New`, `bitbucketserver.NewClient`, and `gitea.New` must inventory and retire native statuses using provider head, ref, iteration, pipeline, token, key-length, and terminal-state rules. Preserve GitHub context, state, description, and target URL, and retire on the requested head with a native neutral terminal status. Exclude wrong GitLab refs and commits while retaining pipeline identity. Reject unmatched or invalid Azure source iterations as incomplete. Preserve Bitbucket Cloud key limits, Bitbucket Server commit scope, and unrelated Gitea statuses.

Normalize context, state, description, URL, ownership evidence, `ProviderToken`, and `HeadCommit`. Never classify ambiguous identity as Atlantis-owned. `DesiredStatus` and `StatusPolicy` from `github.com/runatlantis/atlantis/server/events`, with `StatusNamespace`, must match combined, project, and workflow-hook publication identity. `StatusPolicy.Classify`, `NewStatusReconciler`, and `StatusReconciler.Reconcile` retain desired owned contexts and retire only obsolete owned observations from the requested head.

Bind retirement to identity and make it idempo
